title: FairSteer: Inference Time Debiasing for LLMs with Dynamic Activation Steering
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured social bias in question-answering contexts, specifically for the 'Religion' category from the BBQ dataset. It evaluated the models' tendency to provide stereotypical answers in ambiguous and disambiguated questions related to religion.
findings: The proposed method, FairSteer, effectively improved accuracy and reduced bias scores for the 'Religion' category in the BBQ dataset. Across both zero-shot and few-shot settings, FairSteer consistently outperformed the base models and the CAL baseline in mitigating religious bias.
